Gus: Tiny poll — share a 2-line story + one song you'd press play on the commute.

Mina: 'Found an old postcard. It had my handwriting but not my address.' — Song: Phoebe Bridgers 'Moon Song'

Hector: 'The kettle remembered my grandma's laugh.' — Song: Beirut 'Postcards From Italy' :tea:

jen: 'He left the door unlocked for the cat and forgot the rest.' — Song: Mac DeMarco 'Chamber of Reflection' :cat:

Gus: @jukebox-bot make a 12-min mix called 'Two-Liners & One Song' with these three tracks? No extras.

jukebox-bot: Playlist created: 'Two-Liners & One Song' https://open.spotify.com/playlist/8zExample (3 tracks)

Mina: Vote: react with :heart: if you'd actually read one of these on a rainy tram.

Hector: saving this to the Watercooler board. Thanks for the tiny literary hit, team :coffee:
